caption: A metal spring doorstop mounted on the wall is flicked, and it wobbles wildly and then slows to a stop.

sa.check: A spring doorstop mounted on a wall.
The base stays fixed to the wall.
The order is flick, wobble, stop.

pc.expect: The spring stands still until the finger reaches it; it wobbles from the flick and only then.
pc.fail: The spring is already swaying before the finger arrives; or wobbles while the finger is well away; or the finger flicks it and the spring stays rigid; or it stops and begins wobbling again with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: The wobble is widest right after the flick and shrinks steadily until the spring stands still.
pc.fail: The swings grow after the flick; or hold the same width for the whole clip; or the spring stops dead from a wide swing.

pc.expect: The spring bends and whips as a coil anchored at its base, the rubber tip riding on the free end; the coil straightens as it settles.
pc.fail: The coil kinks and stays bent; or the spring stretches out longer and stays stretched; or the coil goes straight and rigid in mid-swing; or the coils separate into loose rings.

pc.expect: The base plate stays fixed to the wall; the wall around it does not move.
pc.fail: The base plate lifts or rotates on the wall; or the wall ripples at the flick; or the wall around the base bulges.

pc.expect: One doorstop with its base, spring and tip; the spring passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The tip flies off and the spring is then whole again; or the spring passes into the wall or floor; or a second doorstop appears; or the doorstop vanishes.

pc.expect: The doorstop's finish, the wall colour and the floor stay the same.
pc.fail: The spring changes colour; or the tip changes colour or size; or the wall or floor changes.

note: 'Wildly' is not judged as a magnitude; only the wobble's start and decay are.
